a, w = sp.symbols('a w', positive=True)

       (sp.sin(w*t),w/(s*s+w*w)),(sp.cos(w*t),s/(s*s+w*w)),
       (t*sp.exp(-a*t),1/(s+a)**2)]
for f, expected in pairs:

    assert sp.simplify(result-expected)==0

notebooks.title: 二阶归一化与频响核对
notebooks.setupCode:
import numpy as np
from scipy.linalg import expm

cells.code:
m,c,k=250.,2000.,16000.
wn=np.sqrt(k/m); zeta=c/(2*np.sqrt(m*k))
print('m,c,k; wn,zeta:',m,c,k,wn,zeta)
print('极点:',np.roots([m,c,k]))
print('极点角度(deg):',np.degrees(np.arccos(zeta)))
A=np.array([[0.,1.],[-wn*wn,-2*zeta*wn]])
B=np.array([0.,wn*wn])
times=np.linspace(0,3,401)
q=np.array([(np.linalg.solve(A,(expm(A*t)-np.eye(2))@B))[0] for t in times])
print('t=1归一化位移:',(np.linalg.solve(A,(expm(A)-np.eye(2))@B))[0])
print('采样峰值/末样:',q.max(),q[-1])
overshoot=np.exp(-np.pi*zeta/np.sqrt(1-zeta*zeta))
print('连续峰值/峰时:',1+overshoot,np.pi/(wn*np.sqrt(1-zeta*zeta)))
for w in [0.,4.,8.,40.]:
    g=1/(k-m*w*w+1j*c*w)
    print('频率/柔度m每N/归一化/相位deg:',w,abs(g),k*abs(g),np.angle(g,deg=True))
wr=wn*np.sqrt(1-2*zeta*zeta)
wc=wn*np.sqrt(1-2*zeta*zeta+np.sqrt((1-2*zeta*zeta)**2+1))
print('幅值峰频率/归一化峰:',wr,1/(2*zeta*np.sqrt(1-zeta*zeta)))
print('相对直流-3dB频率:',wc)
assert abs(k/abs(k-m*wc*wc+1j*c*wc)-1/np.sqrt(2))<1e-12
for z in [0.,.5,1.,2.]:
    A=np.array([[0.,1.],[-64.,-16*z]])
    samples=np.array([np.linalg.solve(A,(expm(A*t)-np.eye(2))@B)[0] for t in times])
    print('阻尼/极点/采样峰/3s末样:',z,np.linalg.eigvals(A),samples.max(),samples[-1])
print('高频近似 m/N:',1/(m*40**2))
print('路面输入需要分子cs+k，不能套用外力柔度')

notebooks.title: 🧪 动手实验：零极点对消 — 传递函数会隐藏内部状态
notebooks.setupCode:
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('module://matplotlib_inline.backend_inline')
from control import tf, poles, minreal
import warnings; warnings.filterwarnings('ignore')

cells.code:
# 归一化教学信号；顺序 u -> Ga -> Gb -> y，d加在Gb输入
import numpy as np
from scipy.linalg import expm
Ga = tf([1, -1], [1, 2])
Gb = tf([1], [1, -1])
prod = minreal(Ga * Gb, verbose=False)  # 传递函数化简不依赖Slycot
print("约分后极点:", poles(prod))
A = np.array([[-2., 0.], [-3., 1.]])
Bu, Bd = np.array([1., 1.]), np.array([0., 1.])
for t in [0., 1., 5.]:
    integ = np.linalg.solve(A, expm(A*t)-np.eye(2))
    yu, yd = (integ@Bu)[1], (integ@Bd)[1]
    print("t, 输入阶跃输出, 中间扰动阶跃输出:", t, yu, yd)
    assert abs(yu-(1-np.exp(-2*t))/2)<1e-9
    assert abs(yd-np.expm1(t))<1e-9
print("内部特征值:", np.linalg.eigvals(A))
print("反向顺序的中间扰动通道是Ga，极点:", poles(Ga))
for eps in [-0.001, 0., 0.001]:
    p = 1+eps
    residue = eps/(p*(p+2))
    print("极点失配, 不稳定阶跃残余系数:", eps, residue)
assert np.allclose(poles(prod),[-2])
print("对消仅掩盖输入通道，不能保证内部稳定")
